description: Address labels: Labels up to 40 EVM addresses from a committed dataset (37 entries, revision 2026-11-20): USDC/USDT/DAI and wrapped assets per chain, Uniswap/Aerodrome/1inch/0x routers, OP Stack bridges and predeploys, Permit2, Multicall3, burn addresses, a few exchange wallets. Deterministic, offline. Source: X420 dataset. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: labels[]{address, found, label, kind, networks}, dataset{revision, entries}.
